I replied to Ilse in your DM: she uses Bay 30 for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups, as she told me on 14 October.

I got the answer from that DM thread itself, not from gbrain. Asking gbrain for her facts came back empty, both with and without a question. That means the private fact I saved last time (#2) didn't come back. Either it's stored where this session can't read it, or the search is weakened because gbrain has no semantic search set up. So I can't confirm the gbrain copy is still there.

If you want saved preferences to be reliably retrievable later, it's worth checking how gbrain scopes private facts. Until then, her own DM is the dependable record.
